classes.title: Classes
classes.subtitle: Manage groups of learners, assignments, progress, and class activity. Courses are reusable curriculum; classes are the people and delivery.
classes.empty: Create a class and add learners when you are ready.

errors.loadOne: Could not load this student group.
errors.save: Could not save the student group.
errors.delete: Could not delete the student group.
errors.forbidden: Your account does not have permission to manage this group.
errors.notFound: This student group could not be found.
errors.missingAccounts: These learner accounts could not be found: {emails}.

editor.subtitle: Groups only own audience membership; courses and progress remain shared.
editor.name: Name
editor.emailHint: One email per line. In an open class, newly added learners are invited automatically. In a draft or closed class, invitation intent is saved and held until the class is opened.
editor.detailsSubtitle: Update the class name, description, and institution. The class URL stays stable.
editor.studentsSubtitle: Manage the learners who belong to this class and its pending invitations.
editor.dangerBody: Deleting permanently removes the class record and its class-owned membership/invitation links. Close the class instead when you want to preserve its history.

invites.title: Pending class invitations
invites.description: New learner emails are invited automatically when you save. Pending invitations stay here so you can copy the link or resend the email.
invites.emailFailedCopied: Email delivery failed for {email}; the class invite link was copied instead.
invites.deliveryFailed: Could not deliver the class invitation to {email}.
invites.inactiveDescription: These invitations are saved but delivery is paused. Open the class to release unsent invitations; closed classes must be reopened before links or emails can be sent.

dashboard.title: Class overview
dashboard.subtitle: A quick view of learners, assignments, progress, and class communication.
dashboard.emptyAssignments: No assignments are connected to this class yet.
dashboard.emptyStudents: No accepted students are in this class yet.

errors.load: Class progress could not be loaded.

dashboard.announcementsHint: View class updates or open the announcement composer.

wizard.title: Set up a class
wizard.subtitle: Move through the essentials one step at a time. The class is created as a draft so you can review it before learners are contacted.

institution.title: Where does this class belong?
institution.body: Connect the class to an institution, or keep it independent.
institution.label: Institution
institution.hint: You can move the class to another institution later.
institution.empty: You do not have an institution yet.

details.title: Name the class
details.body: Use a clear name learners and staff will recognize.

students.title: Add students
students.body: Add learner emails now, or skip this step. Invitations are held until you open the class.
students.hint: Use one email per line, or separate emails with commas. Leaving this blank is fine.

review.title: Review and create
review.body: Confirm the setup. The class starts as a draft; opening it releases unsent learner invitations and makes it available for new teaching work.
review.name: Class name

lifecycle.closeConfirm: Close this class? Students keep their history, but the class will stop accepting new invitations and new assignment/tutoring targeting until you reopen it.

notice.draft: This class is still a draft. Finish setup, then open it to release pending student invitations and make it available for new teaching work.
notice.closed: This class is closed. History and reports remain available, but it is not available for new invitations, assignments, or tutoring until reopened.

draft.title: No draft classes
draft.body: New classes appear here until you open them.

open.title: No open classes
open.body: Open a draft or reopen a closed class when you are ready to teach.

closed.title: No closed classes
closed.body: Classes you close will stay here for history and reporting.

errors.update: Could not update the class status.

courses.title: Courses
courses.subtitle: Reusable courses currently used by this class through assignments.
courses.error: Class courses could not be loaded.
courses.empty: This class is not using any course yet.
courses.emptyHint: Create an assignment to start using an available course with this class.
